beats.text: The bottleneck is purely parametric memory. Forcing billions of static weights to memorize every world fact guarantees hallucinated answers when knowledge shifts.
beats.visual_focus: A frozen 3D matrix of floating synaptic weights shows dense stone-like walls trapping outdated facts without any update mechanism.

beats.text: Enter Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Instead of forcing weights to memorize trivia. RAG gives the model an open-book library to read dynamically.
beats.visual_focus: The frozen model splits apart; an external dynamic vector store connects seamlessly into the neural generator via illuminated pipelines.
